name: Bluetooth Speaker GTS-1345 Rechargeable Extra Bass wireless portable speaker Mini style 3 inch TWS,FM,USB audio player
description:
Model Number: GTS-1345

Speaker Type: Portable Wireless Speaker

Material: Plastic

Cabinet Material: Plastic

Output Power: 5W (PMPO 5W)

Frequency Range: 100Hz – 20KHz

Speaker Size & Unit: 3" × 1pc

Battery Type: Rechargeable Li-ion Battery (500mAh)

Power Source: Battery

Charging Method: USB

Communication: USB

Support Memory Card: Yes (TF)

Remote Control: No

Display Screen: No

Voice Control: No

Built-in Microphone: No

Number of Loudspeaker Enclosure: 1

Support APP / Apt-X: No

🔹 Features

Extra Bass Sound: Delivers powerful and deep bass for an enhanced listening experience.

Multi-Mode Playback: Supports USB, TF Card, FM Radio, and TWS pairing.

Portable & Compact Design: Ideal for outdoor use, parties, and travel.

Wireless Connectivity: Seamlessly connects with mobile phones, computers, and portable audio players.

Durable Plastic Body: Lightweight yet sturdy for daily use.

Easy Recharge: Comes with a USB charging cable.

Special Features: Wireless, Portable, Mini Speaker

📦 Package Includes

1 × GTS-1345 Wireless Speaker

1 × USB Charging Cable

1 × User Manual
